status: Experimental standalone text server; not selected as the Talk production recipe.
engine: TensorFold Python CUDA EXL3 at db281878ddb836fd0df510d8771ecb7e0fe47d26. No TabbyAPI process.

runtime.draft_vocabulary: All upstream stock IDs plus every tokenizer ID decoding to a Hangul syllable; target head unchanged.

prerequisites: Build the existing qwen38fn_exl3 base image first if sparktalk-qwen38fn_exl3:1.5.4-managed1 is missing.
The pinned checkpoint is already present under the Hugging Face hub cache. Set HF_HUB_CACHE_HOST when that directory is elsewhere.
Stop the active model set in Talk before starting this GPU experiment.
startup: The first CUDA extension build took about 7 minutes on this Spark with MAX_JOBS=1. The persistent cache reuses compiled extensions on later starts.
validation: 17 upstream CUDA checks, two full-model serial/drafted cold-repeat comparisons, and 8 HTTP arithmetic/tool-call checks across streaming/nonstreaming and thinking off/medium passed. Benchmark comparison is recorded in util/talk/docs/qwen38-exl3-tensorfold-comparison-20261020.json.
qualification: Text and tools at native 262K. 1M and image/video input are outside this experiment. Unsupported image input is refused by the upstream text-only server.
storage: Only the hub cache is mounted read-only. Kernel caches use a separate Docker volume. No credential is embedded in this recipe.
